The minimal CachyOS tool gate — four of the six layer candies the retired non-CachyOS
coder workstations were the only live proof of, on the CachyOS (x86_64_v3)
base, and nothing else. Composes the language runtimes (Go, PHP, .NET, Node,
Python, Rust via layer-language-runtimes), pixi and uv tooling, typst, the
github-actions CLI pair (act + actionlint) — plus pod-sshd so the pod has a
long-running service to deploy and probe. Deliberately NOT a coder
workstation: the four candies' own baked checks run here, and the composed IMAGE
is proven by the disposable bed check-cachyos-coder-tools-pod, which asserts one
representative binary per candy on the running container so a candy whose
per-distro section silently no-ops on CachyOS cannot pass.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `cachyos-app-skills`
- `@github.com/opencharly/pod-sshd:v2026.272.0324`
- `@github.com/opencharly/layer-pixi:v2026.330.1550`
- `@github.com/opencharly/layer-language-runtimes:v2026.273.1816`
- `@github.com/opencharly/layer-typst:v2026.272.0407`
- `@github.com/opencharly/layer-github-actions:v2026.272.0135`
